_comment: Generated music + sound design, no downloads. Times match index.html: sections start on the scenes (title, bars, lines, closing number) and the one chime lands when the count-up settles. A restrained underscore (strings, a soft piano pulse, no drums, no build or drop) keeps the numbers in front; no music is also fine for a team report (remove the bed). `showtime retime <project> -d <seconds>` moves them with the scenes. For narration add a voice track and duck the music under it.
